job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced #SalesforceAgenticAIArchitect to lead the design ... Beyond…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] ... looking for an experienced #SalesforceAgenticAIArchitect to lead the design ... Beyond…
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in your commerce platform initiatives, bringing over 5 years of hands-on enterprise e-commerce experience designing and scaling complex platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My deep technical background in SAP Commerce Cloud, headless architectures, and robust API integrations aligns directly with building advanced, high-performing commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Commerce Architecture & Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Enterprise Sync
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global channels and integrated SAP ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Scalable Delivery & Optimization
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, and maintained high platform stability through rigorous testing and code reviews.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit requiring no sponsorship, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, enabling an earliest start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can drive success for your commerce platform.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and integration expertise to help drive your ambitious commerce platform strategies. My background in architecting robust backend systems, REST APIs, and seamless multi-system data flows at Rockwell Automation and Shell equips me to deliver immediate value to your technical initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and enterprise integration expertise to lead and build scalable, high-performing e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an experienced e-commerce developer with 5+ years building enterprise platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, REST APIs) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. With my background in complex integrations and platform design, I would love to connect regarding your architecture roles.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Commerce Architecture Role - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for your commerce architecture and engineering opportunities. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling enterprise platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and complex API integrations) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical execution across backend development and system integrations.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
